text: Door left open during loading: temperature rose gradually from 4°C to 6.5°C over 15 minutes. Driver reported the rear door was left open while loading cargo. Resolution: notify driver immediately, close the door, verify seal after 5 minutes, monitor temperature recovery.

Door left open during inspection: temperature rose from 4°C to 5.8°C in 12 minutes. Driver stopped for routine inspection and left the door open. Resolution: contact driver, close door, check temperature recovery, document incident.

Door seal failure: temperature rose gradually from 4°C to 7.2°C over 45 minutes due to degraded door seal allowing warm air entry. Resolution: notify driver, check seal integrity, apply temporary seal, monitor temperature, schedule maintenance.
Door left ajar during temperature check: temperature rose from 4°C to 5.8°C. Resolution: close door, verify seal, monitor temperature.
Door not properly sealed after loading: temperature rose from 4°C to 6.0°C. Resolution: reseal door, check temperature recovery, document incident.
Driver left door open for 8 minutes: temperature rose from 4°C to 5.2°C. Resolution: contact driver, close door, monitor temperature recovery.
Warehouse staff left door open during inventory: temperature increased by 2.3°C. Resolution: close door, check temperature, document incident.

Loading dock delay: vehicle delayed at loading dock for 60 minutes with door open. Temperature rose from 4°C to 6.8°C. Resolution: close door immediately, monitor temperature recovery, adjust cooling if needed, document delay.

Unloading delay: receiver delayed unloading. Door open for 20 minutes. Temperature rose from 4°C to 5.5°C. Resolution: close door, monitor temperature, communicate with receiver about urgency, adjust cooling.

Door seal degradation: rubber seal on rear door degraded over time. Warm air entering. Temperature rose gradually from 4°C to 7°C. Resolution: notify driver, check seal, apply temporary seal if possible, monitor temperature, schedule replacement.

Compressor failure: rapid temperature rise from 4°C to 8.5°C in 7 minutes. Refrigeration unit stopped working. Resolution: immediately dispatch backup reefer, reroute to nearest maintenance facility, alert receiver of critical delay.

Compressor overheating: temperature rose from 4°C to 7.8°C in 9 minutes. Compressor fan failure detected. Resolution: dispatch maintenance crew, check compressor, monitor temperature, prepare backup unit.

Refrigerant leak: temperature rose slowly from 4°C to 7.5°C over 60 minutes. Compressor running but cooling efficiency reduced. Resolution: dispatch maintenance, check refrigerant levels, transfer cargo to backup unit if temperature exceeds threshold.
Compressor seized: temperature rose from 4°C to 8.7°C in 9 minutes. Resolution: dispatch maintenance, prepare backup reefer, notify receiver.
Compressor motor burned out: temperature rose from 4°C to 9.2°C in 10 minutes. Resolution: dispatch backup reefer, reroute to maintenance, notify receiver.

Condenser blockage: condenser fins blocked by dust or debris. Cooling efficiency reduced. Temperature rose from 4°C to 6.2°C. Resolution: clean condenser, check airflow, monitor temperature recovery, schedule maintenance.
Ice build-up: evaporator coil iced up, reducing cooling capacity. Temperature rose from 4°C to 6.5°C. Resolution: defrost coil, check airflow, adjust defrost cycle settings, monitor temperature.

Power outage: refrigeration unit shut down due to electrical failure. Temperature rose from 4°C to 9.5°C in 15 minutes. Resolution: dispatch backup generator, alert maintenance, notify receiver of critical delay, transfer cargo if temperature exceeds 10°C.

Power surge: electrical surge caused refrigeration unit to restart. Temperature rose from 4°C to 6.5°C during restart. Resolution: monitor temperature recovery, check unit operation, notify maintenance, document incident.

Battery failure: auxiliary battery for IoT sensors depleted. Temperature data intermittent for 2 hours. Resolution: replace battery, check sensor readings, use manual temperature logs, notify maintenance.
Power cut: main power outage for 20 minutes. Temperature rose from 4°C to 9.5°C. Resolution: start backup generator, monitor temperature, notify receiver.
Generator failure: backup generator failed to start during power outage. Temperature rose from 4°C to 11°C. Resolution: dispatch portable generator, transfer cargo, notify receiver.

Power fluctuations: intermittent power caused cooling system to cycle on and off. Temperature fluctuated between 4°C and 7.5°C. Resolution: check electrical supply, stabilise power, monitor temperature.

Driver error: temperature set incorrectly to 0°C instead of 4°C for vaccines. Corrected after 25 minutes. Temperature recovered within 30 minutes. Resolution: contact driver immediately, correct setting, monitor temperature recovery, document incident.
Driver error: door left ajar during routine checks. Temperature rose from 4°C to 6.8°C in 15 minutes. Resolution: contact driver, close door properly, monitor temperature recovery, verify seal.

Driver error: ignored temperature alarm. Temperature rose from 4°C to 8.2°C over 45 minutes. Resolution: contact driver immediately, investigate alarm logs, correct issue, monitor recovery, escalate if needed.
Driver error: turned off cooling unit by mistake. Temperature rose from 4°C to 9°C. Resolution: restart cooling unit, monitor temperature, document incident.
Driver error: misread thermostat and adjusted incorrectly. Temperature rose to 5.5°C. Resolution: contact driver, correct setting, monitor temperature recovery.
Driver error: set defrost cycle incorrectly. Temperature rose to 5.5°C. Resolution: contact driver, adjust setting, monitor temperature.
Driver error: did not monitor temperature. Temperature rose from 4°C to 6.2°C. Resolution: contact driver, investigate cause, monitor recovery.
Driver error: ignored warning lights. Temperature rose from 4°C to 7.0°C. Resolution: contact driver, investigate warning, correct issue, monitor recovery.

Extreme heatwave: external temperature reached 38°C. Internal temperature rose from 4°C to 6.5°C. Resolution: adjust cooling settings to compensate, monitor every 15 minutes, reroute if possible, notify receiver of potential delay.
Extreme cold: external temperature dropped to -15°C. Internal temperature fluctuated between 2°C and 5°C. Resolution: adjust heating settings, monitor closely, check fuel levels, notify receiver.
Heavy rainfall: humidity inside reefer spiked to 95%. Temperature rose from 4°C to 5.5°C. Resolution: check door seals, adjust humidity settings, monitor for condensation, ventilate if necessary.
Snowstorm delayed delivery: temperature rose from 4°C to 6.5°C. Resolution: adjust cooling, monitor temperature, notify receiver of delay.
Hurricane warning: temperature rose from 4°C to 6.2°C. Resolution: adjust cooling, monitor closely, reroute if possible.
Storm caused power fluctuations: temperature rose from 4°C to 6°C. Resolution: monitor temperature, adjust cooling, check power supply.

GPS blackout: GPS signal lost in rural area. Temperature remained stable at 4°C. Resolution: switch to manual tracking, notify dispatcher with last known location, continue on planned route until signal returns.
GPS blackout in tunnel: signal lost in underground tunnel. Temperature stable. Resolution: wait for signal to recover, use inertial navigation, notify dispatcher upon exit.
GPS antenna malfunction: GPS signal intermittent. Temperature stable. Resolution: check antenna connection, switch to backup GPS, notify maintenance, use manual tracking.
GPS signal lost due to solar flare: temperature stable. Resolution: wait for signal recovery, use manual tracking, notify dispatcher.
GPS signal lost in urban canyon: temperature stable. Resolution: use manual tracking, notify dispatcher, continue route.

Sensor malfunction: IoT sensor reading showed erratic temperature fluctuations (±5°C) within seconds. Resolution: cross-check with backup sensor, verify sensor calibration, replace if faulty, use manual temperature logs.
Sensor calibration drift: temperature readings drifting over time. Resolution: recalibrate sensor, cross-check with backup, monitor closely.
Sensor battery low: temperature readings intermittent. Resolution: replace battery, check sensor, use manual logs.
Vibration anomaly: excessive vibration detected (2.5g) on rough terrain. Resolution: slow down, check cargo stability, monitor for packaging damage, alert receiver of potential damage.
Route deviation: vehicle deviated from planned route by 50 km. Resolution: verify route change, check for traffic or road closures, update ETA, notify receiver.
Fuel leak: fuel consumption rate tripled unexpectedly. Resolution: stop vehicle, check for leaks, call maintenance, arrange replacement vehicle if necessary.
Traffic congestion: vehicle stuck in traffic for 45 minutes. Temperature stable. Resolution: monitor fuel levels, update ETA, notify receiver of delay, suggest alternative route.

Emergency stop: driver made emergency stop causing cargo shift. Temperature stable. Resolution: check cargo integrity, document incident, notify warehouse of potential packaging damage, inspect on arrival.

Vaccine shipment: strict 2-8°C range required. Temperature deviation 0.5°C above threshold for 5 minutes. Resolution: immediate driver notification, adjust cooling, check door seal, monitor every 2 minutes until stable.

Pharmaceutical shipment: 2-8°C range. Temperature rose to 9°C for 10 minutes due to compressor cycling issue. Resolution: dispatch maintenance, check compressor, monitor temperature recovery, notify receiver.
Fresh produce: 0-4°C range. Temperature rose to 5°C for 20 minutes due to door open. Resolution: notify driver, close door, monitor spoilage risk, check produce quality on arrival.
Frozen goods: -18°C required. Temperature rose to -15°C for 30 minutes. Resolution: immediate backup dispatch, check freezer unit, reroute to nearest cold storage if needed, notify receiver.

Dairy products: 0-4°C range. Temperature rose to 6°C for 15 minutes due to power fluctuation. Resolution: monitor temperature, adjust cooling, notify receiver of potential quality issue, inspect on arrival.
Meat products: -2°C to 2°C range. Temperature rose to 4°C due to door open. Resolution: notify driver, close door, monitor spoilage, inspect on arrival.
Seafood: -1°C to 0°C range. Temperature rose to 2°C due to power outage. Resolution: dispatch backup, monitor temperature, inspect on arrival.
Flowers: 2-8°C range. Temperature rose to 10°C due to extreme weather. Resolution: adjust cooling, monitor, notify receiver.
Chemicals: 15-25°C range. Temperature rose to 30°C due to compressor failure. Resolution: dispatch backup, monitor, notify receiver.
Biological samples: 2-8°C range. Temperature rose to 10°C due to power outage. Resolution: immediate backup, monitor, notify receiver.
Blood products: 2-6°C range. Temperature rose to 8°C due to door left open. Resolution: notify driver, close door, monitor, inspect on arrival.
Cold start: refrigeration unit started after long idle. Temperature took 20 minutes to stabilise at 4°C. Resolution: allow stabilisation, monitor closely, pre-cool before loading.
Temperature sensor drift: readings slowly increasing over time. Resolution: recalibrate sensor, cross-check with manual measurement, replace if needed.
Thermostat malfunction: temperature control inaccurate. Resolution: check thermostat, recalibrate, monitor temperature.
Evaporator fan failure: reduced airflow causing uneven cooling. Resolution: dispatch maintenance, check fan, monitor temperature.
Condenser fan failure: reduced heat rejection. Temperature gradually rising. Resolution: dispatch maintenance, check fan, monitor temperature.
Defrost cycle failure: ice build-up on evaporator. Temperature rising. Resolution: manual defrost, check defrost timer, monitor temperature.
High ambient temperature: external temperature 40°C. Cooling system struggling. Resolution: adjust cooling, monitor closely, reroute if needed.
Low refrigerant pressure: cooling efficiency reduced. Temperature slowly rising. Resolution: dispatch maintenance, check refrigerant levels, monitor.
High refrigerant pressure: system overcharged. Temperature fluctuating. Resolution: dispatch maintenance, check pressure, adjust refrigerant.
Expansion valve failure: uneven cooling. Temperature fluctuating. Resolution: dispatch maintenance, check valve, monitor temperature.
Drier filter blockage: reduced refrigerant flow. Cooling efficiency reduced. Resolution: dispatch maintenance, replace filter, monitor temperature.
Air in refrigerant system: cooling efficiency reduced. Resolution: dispatch maintenance, evacuate system, recharge, monitor.
Vehicle breakdown: truck broke down. Temperature rising due to no cooling. Resolution: dispatch backup vehicle, transfer cargo, notify receiver.
Flat tyre: vehicle stopped on roadside. Temperature monitored. Resolution: change tyre, monitor temperature, update ETA.
Accident: vehicle involved in minor collision. Cargo checked. Resolution: check cargo integrity, notify receiver, inspect on arrival.
Border crossing delay: vehicle held at customs. Temperature monitored. Resolution: monitor temperature, update ETA, notify receiver.
Ferry delay: vehicle waiting for ferry. Temperature monitored. Resolution: monitor temperature, update ETA, adjust cooling if needed.
Road closure: unexpected road closure. Vehicle rerouted. Resolution: verify reroute, update ETA, monitor temperature, notify receiver.
Tunnel closure: vehicle stuck in tunnel. Temperature monitored. Resolution: monitor temperature, update ETA, notify receiver.
High wind warning: vehicle slowed due to high winds. Temperature monitored. Resolution: adjust speed, monitor temperature, notify receiver.
Fog delay: vehicle delayed due to dense fog. Temperature monitored. Resolution: monitor temperature, update ETA, notify receiver.
Landslide: road blocked by landslide. Vehicle rerouted. Resolution: verify reroute, monitor temperature, notify receiver.
Flooding: road flooded. Vehicle rerouted. Resolution: verify reroute, monitor temperature, notify receiver.
Fuel shortage: vehicle running low on fuel. Resolution: refuel at nearest station, monitor temperature, update ETA.
Engine overheating: vehicle engine temperature high. Resolution: pull over, check engine, monitor cargo temperature.
Tyre pressure warning: low tyre pressure. Resolution: check tyres, adjust pressure, monitor cargo.
Brake issue: vehicle brake warning. Resolution: pull over, check brakes, monitor cargo temperature.
Battery warning: vehicle battery low. Resolution: check battery, monitor cargo temperature, update ETA.
Alternator failure: vehicle electrical system failing. Resolution: pull over, call maintenance, monitor cargo temperature.
Coolant leak: vehicle coolant system leaking. Resolution: pull over, check coolant, monitor cargo temperature.
Oil pressure warning: low oil pressure. Resolution: pull over, check oil, monitor cargo temperature.
Check engine light: engine warning light. Resolution: check engine code, monitor cargo temperature, notify receiver.
Exhaust temperature high: high exhaust temperature warning. Resolution: pull over, check exhaust, monitor cargo temperature.
Transmission warning: transmission issue. Resolution: pull over, check transmission, monitor cargo temperature.
Suspension issue: vehicle suspension problem. Resolution: slow down, check suspension, monitor cargo temperature.
Steering issue: steering warning. Resolution: pull over, check steering, monitor cargo temperature.
Door sensor fault: door open warning falsely triggered. Resolution: check sensor, monitor temperature, replace if needed.
Humidity sensor fault: humidity reading inaccurate. Resolution: check sensor, recalibrate, monitor temperature.
Temperature display fault: display showing incorrect temperature. Resolution: cross-check with manual measurement, replace display.
Data transmission failure: IoT data not transmitting. Resolution: check network, use manual logs, notify maintenance.
Firmware update required: system update pending. Resolution: schedule update during maintenance, monitor temperature.
Battery drain: IoT sensor battery draining fast. Resolution: replace battery, check sensor, monitor temperature.
Memory error: sensor data logging error. Resolution: reset system, check data logs, monitor temperature.
Clock synchronization error: timestamp mismatch. Resolution: sync clock, check data logs, monitor temperature.
Calibration overdue: sensor calibration required. Resolution: schedule calibration, check readings, monitor temperature.
Temperature logging gap: missing temperature data. Resolution: check logger, use manual logs, monitor temperature.
Alarm system failure: temperature alarm not triggering. Resolution: check alarm system, test alarm, monitor temperature.
Remote monitoring failure: remote access not available. Resolution: check connection, use local monitoring, notify maintenance.
